author: blu
body: THE MEMO IS KEYED ON THE AGENT AND THE DEPTH, AND KEYING IT ON THE AGENT ALONE WOULD BE WRONG. The depth cap truncates the walk, so an agent's score is a function of how much depth budget is left when it is reached: at depth 5 `best-vouch-score` asks at depth 6, is refused by the cap, and the score collapses to `direct-score`, while the same agent at depth 0 gets the full five-deep walk. An agent with no direct score and one good voucher genuinely scores above zero at depth 0 and exactly zero at depth 5. Cache that under a bare agent name and the first answer poisons every later one.

author: blu
body: The memo is a `mutable` record, and every function here returns an Integer rather than the memo, so each one BORROWS it -- which is what lets `best-vouch-score` hand the same memo to both the voucher's lookup and its own tail on one path. A function that RETURNED the memo would consume it and the second hand-off would be CDX2062.
